svg.title: Measured, on a log-log axis: the curves separate where the counts said
svg.desc: A hand-drawn log-log plot of sorting time against array size. A green merge-sort line of slope 1.06 and a blue qsort line of slope 1.11 run almost parallel, with qsort 1.75 times slower; a red selection-sort line of slope 1.95 climbs far more steeply and is continued as a dashed extrapolation off the top of the chart. An inset shows insertion sort at 1700 nanoseconds beating merge sort at n equals 96, and a crossed-out box denies that big-O tells you which algorithm is faster.
svg.text: Measured, on a log-log axis: the curves separate where the counts said
selection sort - slope 1.95, that is n^2
at n = 32 000: selection 890 ms vs merge 1.9 ms = 471x
